articles.headlineTranslated: Chen Wei serves as a member of the Party Leadership Group and Vice President of the Chinese Academy of Engineering. She has made outstanding contributions to the prevention and control of many major epidemics and was awarded the national honorary title of "People's Hero" - thepaper.cn
articles.headlineJa: チェン・ウェイは党指導グループのメンバーであり、中国工程院の副院長を務めています。彼女は多くの大規模な伝染病の予防と抑制に多大な貢献をし、「人民の英雄」という国家名誉称号を授与された - thepaper.cn
